title: Muhammad Iqbal's birth chart
metaDescription: Muhammad Iqbal's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 17.0° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mercury holds a trine to Saturn at 0.8° — close enough to weld thinking to structure. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 17.0° into Scorpio — the second decan, which the old scheme hands to Jupiter. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 14.4° Scorpio, Venus at 1.7° Capricorn, Mars at 15.6° Pisces. Mercury in a water sign reads as thought steeped in tone and memory; Venus in an earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Saturn — a trine holding at 0.8°. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required. Behind it, Venus conjunction Jupiter at 0.9°, and Mercury trine Mars at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Venus, Uranus, Neptune close a triangle of trines. A grand trine is read as self-sufficiency in one element: the current circulates whether or not anything is asked of it.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks one placement here. Jupiter in Capricorn at 2.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in water, 4 in earth, 1 in fire by element, 5 fixed, 2 cardinal, 2 mutable by modality. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Sagittarius into Capricorn during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.7° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
